title: Sprint 14 — Conversation Mode & Speaker Diarization
description: Diarization honesty + capacity for conversation mode (ADR-0034). True DER cannot be computed in production (no ground truth), so the honesty signals are the proxy: a diarizer that has started GUESSING shows up as a falling UNKNOWN rate paired with a rising manual-override rate. Read the two together — neither means anything alone.

panels.title: Diarization honesty — the DER proxy (review weekly with the clinical lead)
UNKNOWN speaker rate — THE honesty signal
panels.description: unknown / (labeled + unknown + pending) over committed words. Some UNKNOWN is CORRECT and expected — overlapping speech and turn-straddling segments must abstain rather than guess (ADR-0034). A rate near ZERO is the alarming case: it means the clusterer is confidently labeling audio it cannot actually resolve. A rate climbing above ~35% means separation is failing (mic placement, a third voice, near-identical voices). Counted on COMMITTED words only — partials are re-emitted every tick.

panels.title: Manual override rate per session
panels.description: Manual SetSpeakerMapping events / conversation sessions started. Every override is a clinician telling us the inference was wrong (or that it abstained and they assigned it). Rising ⇒ the doctor/patient heuristic is mis-mapping; check whether ASR quality dropped, since the clinician-register vocabulary signal degrades with WER and the inference then abstains by design.

panels.title: Speaker-label outcomes (volume context)
panels.description: Committed conversation words by outcome. 'pending' = diarization had not resolved the speaker when the word committed (labels legitimately trail text by up to one window). Sustained high 'pending' means the clusterer never bootstrapped — usually a single-voice session mistakenly started in conversation mode.

panels.title: Diarization cost per window (p50/p95)
panels.description: VAD + ECAPA embedding + clustering, per 4 s window. Must stay a small fraction of the window budget so the ADR-0013 partial p95 ≤ 1100 ms target holds with both models resident. CPU reference (Apple M5, ADR-0034): p95 ≈ 57 ms ≈ 10% of pipeline. Re-baseline on the A10G rig.

panels.title: Sessions by mode
panels.description: A conversation session costs MDX_CONVERSATION_SESSION_WEIGHT (default 2) capacity slots because it holds two models resident, so 4 dictation OR 2 conversation OR a weighted mix per worker.

panels.title: Conversation starts refused (consent gate)
panels.description: Rate of gpu_full rejections vs consent refusals. A steady consent_refused rate is a WORKFLOW signal, not an outage: clinicians are trying to start conversation mode for encounters whose patient has not granted a 'recording' consent. Sustained gpu_full means the weighted cap needs re-tuning against measured GPU headroom (todo.md, S14).
